disc.full: SIMULATION — concept demonstration, not flight software. Position is replayed along the planned route; there is no live positioning. Time, daylight, temperature and dose limits are assumptions listed under “Assumptions”. Dose uses Curiosity RAD averages measured on the rover deck {where}, not a forecast and not the dose inside a suit. Route A and route B rates were measured 13 years apart (2012–13 and 2025). The difference between them must not be read as an effect of altitude or location; this data cannot separate the two. Ground temperature is the REMS hourly mean for the selected season, not suit or equipment temperature. Slope comes from a 5 m grid; smaller obstacles are not shown. Line of sight ignores relays and diffraction.
disc.short: SIMULATION — concept demonstration, not flight software. Limits are assumptions; see Setup.

selftest.intro: Every value below comes from evaState()/evaPlan(), the same functions the replay uses. Reference values: Plan/09 4-4 hand cases, the planning-panel route summary (same expressions as the panel), and the independent Python recomputation of stage 4 (scripts/44_route_validate.py).
